title: 123 Cyber deep dossier candidate

selectedGap.reason: The owner requested a deep dossier for 123 Cyber to assess a new Canadian company record and its decision-useful cyber-assurance, sovereign-cloud and offline edge-processing relevance.

guardrailNotes: This candidate is private review material only; it does not establish procurement eligibility, endorsement, customer interest, accredited-assessor status or classified demand.

candidates.reviewerRationale: Coverage value: 123 Cyber adds a Montreal defence supplier with three distinct offerings—123 AuditPrep, 123 Capture and 123 Enclave—covering compliance preparation, offline edge transcription and Canadian sovereign-cloud collaboration. Evidence: 11 durable sources led by 123cyber.ca, Corporations Canada, ACOA, Vimy Forge, ThinkOn, Calian, National Defence, PSPC and CSE support identity, location, capabilities, program participation and current activity without a material conflict. Mission/Public Need read: 123 Capture plausibly informs Edge Data Processing, while AuditPrep and Enclave may inform the published Supply-chain cyber-risk assessment and assurance need; these are derived reads, not procurement fit. Unknowns: Public sources do not establish accreditation scope, Capture performance specifications, Enclave responsibility boundaries or exhaustive customer deployments. Reviewer action: Verify those deployment and certification boundaries, then assess the three cited offerings and Vimy Forge and Calian relationships for an amber organization record.
reviewWarnings: 123 Capture's public evidence does not disclose performance benchmarks, supported hardware, accreditation status or the boundaries of Canadian Army and Navy use reported by Vimy Forge.
123 Enclave's sources describe CPCSC and CMMC mappings and Canadian hosting, but do not establish 123 Cyber as an accredited assessor or allocate customer-versus-provider control responsibilities.
Public evidence identifies partnerships and program participation but does not establish exhaustive customers, contract values, financing or a complete current operating-ownership structure.

duplicateCheck.note: A production service-role name and domain query plus the public atlas search found no 123 Cyber organization, and the live active-review target set was empty.
